title: Scenario (illustration)
description: An illustration attached to a branch, of exactly two kinds, never blurred: a real cited precedent, or a constructed scenario labeled as such. A branch no one has felt will not be decided.

narrative.description: Precedent: what happened, quoting the source, no embellishment. Constructed: one paragraph in the company's own terms, ending at the top harm.

source_url.description: Required for a precedent. No URL = no claim.

told_in_our_terms.description: Constructed scenarios are grounded strictly in inventory — never assume tools they don't have.

label.description: Constructed scenarios carry 'Illustrative — not a real event' on every surface, including published views.

likelihood_effect.description: A same-industry precedent moves the branch's likelihood to precedent or probable.
